papers.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: Turns an agent's own finished trajectories into natural-language hindsight skills, then re-scores actions with and without those skills to build a dense token-level self-distillation signal that is trained jointly with outcome-based reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Demystifying On-Policy Distillation: Roles, Pathologies, and Regulations
papers.what: Shows on-policy distillation acts as an exploration catalyst whose success depends on signal quality, names two failure modes (student-teacher mismatch, length exploitation), and fixes them with advantage clipping and log-scale compression.

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.what: A fully open 4B video multimodal LLM that inflates a Vision Transformer to 3D and adds adaptive frame resolution for streaming, beating larger open-source models on general, long-form, and streaming video benchmarks.

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.what: Reframes interactive world models around a game engine's explicit action-state-observation loop, argues persistent explicit state matters more than pixel prediction, and releases a 90-hour Black Myth: Wukong dataset with ground-truth states.
papers.builds_on: World Models (Ha & Schmidhuber 2018); Navigation World Models; Offline RL (Levine 2020)
